title: Deion Sanders: I want to meet Todd Monken to talk about Shedeur—as a coach, not as a dad

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Deion Sanders: I want to meet Todd Monken to talk about Shedeur—as a coach, not as a dad
sources.description: Colorado head coach Deion Sanders says he'd like to talk to new Browns head coach Todd Monken about quarterback Shedeur Sanders — not because Deion is Shedeur's dad, but because Deion was Shedeur's college coach.
